subject: Vendor onboarding — frontdoor vs backdoor for invoice submission and required line-item fields
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenwave.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: finance_ops@greenwave.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — question about submitting invoices

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. Two quick follow-ups from our AP team before we kick off:

1) Do you require us to submit invoices through Redwood's vendor portal (preferred) or is email delivery to a billing inbox acceptable as a fallback? If both are supported, can you share the portal URL and the email address you prefer?

2) We attached a sample invoice and a CSV export of a couple of recent invoices. Can you confirm the minimal row-level fields you need for automatic PO matching? Our export currently has: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, line_tax, total.

We want to avoid manual intervention if possible. Also, what format/column name must we use for the PO so your system reliably matches?

Attached: greenwave_invoice_sample.pdf, sample_rows.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Greenwave Logistics
(elena.ruiz@greenwave.com)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — question about submitting invoices

Hi Elena,

Great questions — thanks for sending the samples. Short answers up front:

- Frontdoor: portal is preferred for day-to-day invoice ingestion (automated acknowledgements + faster PO-matching). URL: https://vendor.redwood.com/onboard (internal link below).
- Backdoor: emailing invoices to supplier-invoices@redwood.com is supported as a fallback during early go-live. When emailed, please put the PO number in the subject as: PO 12345 so our parser picks it up reliably.

For automated line-level PO matching we recommend the CSV include at minimum these columns (exact header text helps):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (exact match to our PO system)
- line_number
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price (numeric decimal)
- line_tax (optional, numeric)
- line_total

Important notes:
- If you send a consolidated invoice that references multiple POs, include po_number on each line.
- We map on po_number + line_number; if you don't have a line_number, we attempt fuzzy mapping on description and totals which increases manual review.

I've attached our invoice schema spreadsheet (redwood_invoice_schema.xlsx) with sample header names and a minimal test CSV layout. Marissa — please add any AP-specific tolerances. Karthik — tagging you for PO formatting edge cases (blank line_number, tax breakouts).

If you prefer, we can take the sample_rows.csv you sent and run a quick dry-run through the portal parser and return a short exception report. Would you like us to do that?

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — question about submitting invoices

Hi Elena — quick AP checklist from our side:

- Portal uploads: please ZIP invoices when you bulk-upload >25 files. Portal accepts PDF, PNG and single-tab CSV (UTF-8).
- Email fallback: subject should start with "INV: <invoice_number> | PO: <po_number>". Attach the PDF, and also paste a single-line CSV row in the email body if possible — that speeds ingestion.
- Taxes: we accept either line_tax OR a separate tax_total column; if both are present we validate but prefer line-level to reconcile tax by line.
- Currency: include a currency column (USD / EUR) if you ever switch. Default is USD.

Acceptance criteria for automated routing to AP: CSV headers must match the sheet Neha attached (redwood_invoice_schema.xlsx). If anything deviates more than two columns we flag for manual review.

Operational note: if you choose the portal, we can provision your vendor account today and run a test file. If you can't use the portal, send a short test email to supplier-invoices@redwood.com and we'll process it to show you the exception report.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior AP Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenwave.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: finance_ops@greenwave.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — question about submitting invoices

Thanks Neha / Marissa — that's very helpful. A couple quick clarifications after we reviewed the schema:

1) Our ERP doesn't export a line_number field by default unless we do a custom extract. Will you accept an incremental line index (1..n) generated at export time?

2) For line_tax we export a combined tax_percent and tax_amount. Do you need both? We can include tax_amount per line but prefer not to send percent.

Attached: sample_rows.csv (we added an incremental_line_index column)

If portal provisioning is fast and you can run a dry-run, please do — we'd rather validate before our first live batch.

Best,
Elena

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — question about submitting invoices

Hi Elena — quick answers and next steps: 

- incremental_line_index is fine for line_number as long as it's unique per invoice_number and starts at 1. Please name the column line_number (we'll map line_number -> incremental_line_index on ingest).
- line_tax: tax_amount per line is sufficient for us. tax_percent is optional. If you can include tax_amount, we reconcile totals automatically.

Next steps:
1) We'll provision your vendor portal account today (you'll receive an invite from vendor-admin@redwood.com).
2) Please upload the sample_rows.csv to the portal or, if you prefer, reply to this thread with the CSV and we'll run a dry-run and send an exception report by EOD tomorrow.
3) If the dry-run is clean, we'll schedule go-live for Monday 2027-05-31 and switch routing to the portal.

I'll kick off the portal invite now. Thanks again for being flexible — we'll follow up with the exception report.

Cheers,
Neha
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
